newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable in dull trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in quiet late trading on Wednesday as buyers stayed sidelined amid falls in Malaysia, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,470-75 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but quotes were also heard at 1,465 rupiah. Crude palm oil offer prices remained unchanged at 1,300 rupiah in the North Sumatran city of Medan.
"The falls in Malaysia are keeping buyers at the sidelines," one trader said. "The expectation is that local prices will ease further through the week."
Traders said a shortage of crude palm oil was causing delays in shipment at the Sumatran ports of Belawan and Dumai.

"I heard there were several vessels waiting at the ports because the shippers could not get the oil," one trader said. "Crude palm oil supply is tight because harvesting was halted for more than a week during Lebaran (Eid al-Fitr)."
Traders also said exporters were hoping to ship more crude palm oil ahead of March, when export taxes were expected to be higher than in February.
